run_validation_pretrained: run validation on a dataset using a pretrained EfficientNet model with default settings
run_validation_amp: run validation with native Torch AMP mixed precision for faster inference on GPU
run_validation_torchscript: run validation using a TorchScript-compiled model for optimized inference performance
run_validation_multigpu: run validation across multiple GPUs using DataParallel for distributed inference
run_validation_checkpoint: run validation with a custom checkpoint file to evaluate a trained model
